coaching.headline: We won two early fights but converted neither, then lost a full-squad fight that broke the game open.
coaching.team: We opened well: Khaimera and Drongo caught Aurora and Maco 2-0 at the Fangtooth at 6.7, one of two majors we took in the first ten minutes (the other a Seedling at 7), and won another skirmish at 9.4. Neither got turned into a tower or a camp, while they cashed four of their five fight wins. The break came at 17.3: all five of us engaged a teamfight at our Outer Tower and lost it 2-5, and their Fangtooth fell a minute later. From there it cascaded - their Primal Fangtooth fell at 24 with several of us already dead going in, and we gave up two Inner Towers, the Inhibitor and the Core by 27 minutes. River was theirs most of the game (19 takes to our 5), and the team never built an answer to Maco's healing or the three magical damage sources on their side.
coaching.whatShiftedIt: The 17.3 teamfight: the whole squad engaged at our Outer Tower with nobody missing and lost it 2-5. Their Fangtooth fell a minute later, and the objective losses never stopped after that.
coaching.whatWorked: The Fangtooth pickoff at 6.7 - Khaimera and Drongo caught Aurora and Maco for a clean 2-0 - was the one well-timed engage of the game.

focus.title: Convert a won fight into an objective
focus.evidence: We won 2 fights (6.7 and 9.4) and converted 0 of them into a tower or camp within 90 seconds; they converted 4 of their 5 wins.
focus.action: The instant a fight is won, path to the nearest contestable objective instead of resetting to lane - we won at 6.7 and 9.4 but still conceded Fangtooth to them at 12 and 18, because a won fight that buys nothing is wasted tempo.

6.7.call: Khaimera and Drongo caught Aurora and Maco 2-0 at the Fangtooth - the right shape: commit only once the pick is already won, not because the camp timer is up.

15.6.call: Wrong fight to start: Khaimera was pinned in a losing jungle lane, while Gadget was alive and ahead in his own lane - the better call was to rotate in and flip the numbers instead of going down 1-3.

17.3.call: All five engaged here and lost 2-5 at our Outer Tower - no absences, no excuses. This is the fight that handed over their Fangtooth a minute later and started the cascade.

23.9.call: Drongo and Crunch were both alive and ahead in their lanes when this went 0-3 at the Primal Fangtooth - a rotation from either lane evens the numbers before conceding the biggest camp of the game.

1fca3ad1-10c1-487b-ae79-6ed5fd920535.build: Finished only Sky Splitter and Rapture, missing the meta core's Overlord and Cursed Scroll, and carried no magic resist into a comp with three magical damage sources - the matchup flag the team never answered.
1fca3ad1-10c1-487b-ae79-6ed5fd920535.eternal: Supports run an unmodeled kit here, so any Eternal read for Bayle is a model suggestion naming the general peel-vs-damage lens, not a record of what was actually picked.

3b78091f-0166-4628-8ea7-9b44815d0bee.build: Scattershot and Onixian Quiver over the meta Lightning Hawk and Tainted Rounds left Drongo without the anti-heal the matchup called for against Maco's healing (13,127 healing done).
3b78091f-0166-4628-8ea7-9b44815d0bee.eternal: A mobility-leaning minor would have helped him disengage Aurora's catches (two of his five deaths came from her), but this is a suggestion, not his recorded pick.

00e503ae-096a-4ee2-a7ce-d3c6a3611b1e.build: Volcanica and Vyzar Carapace instead of the meta Mutilator and Tainted Blade left no magic resist against a three-magical-source enemy comp - the exact flag on this player - but with zero kills and three solo catches, the build wasn't the deciding factor in his night.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Soulbinder, Azure Core and Oblivion Crown skip the meta's Entropy and Overseer, but Gadget still led the team in hero damage - the build wasn't what cost the solo-catch death that fed the Outer Tower loss at 15.3.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Ashbringer, Claw Of Hermes and Draconum again skipped all three jungle core items (Overlord, Basilisk, Rapture) for the second film in a row, with no magic resist against a three-magical enemy comp either - the same gap that was flagged and missed last time.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Jungle is Khaimera's best-fit role on this roster, so the lesson here is the completed core, not the role.

threats: Heal-stacking: Maco. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought none.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s), Gadget Security Gate (root 1s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Old Rusty slow → Gag Grenade silence → Rad Rounds basics → Shrapnel Cannon armor shred
ourKits.winCondition: kite back, stack Wastelander bleed and Rad Rounds, melt from range
ourKits.playWith: peel and frontline so he can free-fire
ourKits.playAgainst: low mobility — dive him or break LoS through his poke; he folds to hard engage

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch gap-close stun → Right Crunch knockup → empowered Left Crunch, sustain via Re-Crunch
ourKits.winCondition: all-in a squishy with the empowered combo and heal back through Re-Crunch
ourKits.passive: post-ability empowered basic that refunds cooldowns
ourKits.playWith: peel-stripping engage so he reaches the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: peel/CC him off — without resets he's stranded; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch

ourKits.combo: Security Gate root → Sticky Mine → Tesla Dome zone ult
ourKits.winCondition: root with the gate and trap a fight inside the Tesla Dome
ourKits.passive: FDA stacks grant scaling magical power
ourKits.playWith: frontline that holds enemies in her Dome
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge the gate; spread vs the Dome — she's immobile, dive her

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

enemyKits.combo: stance-swap with Zero Shift → Tachyon Lance (ranged) or melee chain → Limit Break on Overheat
enemyKits.winCondition: build Heat and burst with Limit Break, flexing range and melee
enemyKits.passive: damage builds Heat → Overheat unlocks Limit Break
enemyKits.playWith: peel that lets her ramp Heat safely
enemyKits.playAgainst: pressure her before Overheat; CC during the melee stance

enemyKits.combo: Maco Gift! (heal ally / hurt enemy) → Maco Fly! slam → Maco Strike! charged line ult
enemyKits.winCondition: poke and heal-flex while landing the charged ult
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge the charged Strike; pressure his low survivability

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Ricochet stun → Bad Medicine zone → Infuse heal an ally → Neural Regenesis revive
enemyKits.winCondition: keep an ally alive with Infuse + the revive ult and poke with Ricochet
enemyKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
enemyKits.playAgainst: she can't heal herself — dive HER; bait the revive before committing
